import csv
import re

names = set()
with open('names.csv', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        name = row['name']
        # Collapse runs of spaces
        name = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', name)
        # Strip leading/trailing whitespace
        name = name.strip()
        # Ignore case
        name = name.lower()

            names.add(name)
